title: xDrip follower sees compressed bg scale if on mmol/l while master on mg/dl
body:
![photo_2020-04-13 20 57 44](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/11962538/79150667-74d16580-7dc9-11ea-863a-ce161c20cc4d.jpeg)

This happens if the master records mg/dl data (and treatments are "scaled" into the range), and a follower runs mmol/l (for whichever reason). Apparently treatment y values aren't scaled.
Since there are entries with a bg value in the 100-150 range, the real bg range is shown, with correct values, in a compressed (by a factor 18) manner.
